dataset.source: NYC TLC yellow taxi monthly parquet files

experiment.selection: Lowest mean validation MAE across evaluated horizons; seed and feature ablations excluded from main selection.
models: Persistence, daily/weekly seasonal and historical-average baselines
GCN-GRU across four graphs and a random control
Graph WaveNet with fixed and adaptive supports

graphs.name: Contiguity
graphs.construction: 50-foot buffered polygon intersections; isolated zones linked to three nearest neighbors.

graphs.name: Distance (kNN)
graphs.construction: Gaussian distance weights over eight nearest zones; symmetrized.

graphs.name: OD flow
graphs.construction: Log two-way trip flow; ten strongest positive links per zone; symmetrized.

graphs.name: Correlation
graphs.construction: Positive residual log-demand correlation after removing hour-of-week means; ten strongest links; symmetrized.
